parts.text: {"summary": "The request is for QuietNote Captions Teams, an accessibility tool for automatic captions on internal training videos, costing $7,000 annually for 5 users. The requester is Mia Thompson from Customer Success, with a manager and department head both being Robert King. The department has sufficient budget ($7,000 requested, $7,000 available). No existing tool in the catalog matches the request, and there is no purchase history for this vendor in the department. The vendor QuietNote is approved with current security and legal status (reviewed 2026-05-01, within 365-day validity). The business purpose is clear and meets accessibility needs.
